soldier: Labrum rather short, the apex narrowly rounded, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae all present. Mandibles rather stout and short, the mandible length less than the head width and about half the head capsule length, apex rather curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct. About 11 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Antennae 16–17 segments. Waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.29–0.34, the ratio of the narrowest part to the head width about 1:8 and to the postmental length about 1:10 to 1:12. Pronotum kidney-shaped, anterior margin with a broad V-shaped incision, lateral margins steeply sloping posteriorly, the middle of the posterior margin also with a shallow V-shaped incision, median emargination index about 18%. Setae in the middle region of the thoracic tergites: about 60 on each of the pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
